item.title: Couple loses dream home to bridge project 1 month after moving in
item.summary: In Massachusetts, a newly built residence was taken by state officials for a bridge project, much to the dismay of the Hendel couple who relocated there only a month prior. This eminent domain decision affects thirteen properties in Round Hill as the state prepares for Sagamore Bridge's replacement, causing distress over disrupted retirement plans and unsettled financial futures.
